finalText:
**`CHANGELOG.md` has a 4.2.0 section now, dated 2026-08-23.**

Out of 380 commits since 4.1, one real feature and eleven real fixes stood out. Everything else was dependency bumps, refactors, tests, and CI — nothing a user would notice.

**Added:** webhook deliveries that fail now retry automatically with backoff.

**Fixed:** an expired token returns 401 instead of 403, the DB layer stopped logging full request bodies, trace IDs survive retries, null-cursor pagination no longer breaks on queue/API/webhook/DB list endpoints, trailing slashes trim correctly, empty allowlists work, duplicate headers are gone, two separate HTTP client resource leaks are closed, the latency histogram reports correct units, and the token parser's error message is clearer.

No breaking changes this time. I also removed the old "4.2.0 goes here" placeholder comment since it's filled in now.
